entities.name: decider-combinator
entities.player_description:
Transition Handling
- wipes memory when a transition is detected
- values begin to decrement when over 24

The only case where the values in this combinator can go over 30 is during the transition from promethium to a non-promethium science research due to the lead lab consuming science faster than the science is being removed.

entities.name: decider-combinator
entities.player_description: Memory cell of active running science

entities.name: constant-combinator
entities.player_description:
Sub tick clock for each quality level
The clock needs to insert 1 science every 14400/889 ticks. So for stack 16 normal science, that is 230400/889 ticks. The clock increases by 889 each tick and each quality is a multiple of 230400.

[virtual-signal=signal-hourglass] = the least common multiple of 1,2,3,4,6 times 2 times the base of 230400. This is to ensure that all clocks are even so the tick and tock of the subtick clock can hit in each cycle
